skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the geographical, natural, human, historical, political, educational, economic, and social characteristics of English-speaking countries.
Understand the historical events and their impact on the current state of English-speaking countries.
Understand the political systems, governance structures, and electoral processes of English-speaking countries.
Understand the economic conditions, wealth distribution, income, and expenditure patterns in English-speaking countries.
Understand the education systems, including public and private schools, and the challenges and reforms in education.
Understand the social attitudes, identity, and behaviors of people in English-speaking countries.
Understand the business environment, culture, ethics, and practices in English-speaking countries.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve problems related to cultural, economic, and social issues.
Learn how to find, retrieve, and synthesize information about cultures, societies, and economies of English-speaking countries.
Work effectively in groups and individually to present and defend viewpoints on cultural topics.
Develop the ability to learn independently and manage personal study schedules.
Improve skills in presenting information and arguments in a clear, organized, and engaging manner.
Analyze videos related to cultural, economic, and social issues in English-speaking countries.
Analyze case studies related to cultural, ethical, and business issues in English-speaking countries.
Expand vocabulary related to cultural, social, economic, and political aspects of English-speaking countries.
Enhance cross-cultural communication skills to interact effectively with people from different cultural backgrounds.
